INTERIM (August) report — separator sheet only: 'Tyrone Fields 8/03/2021 / INTERIM: Required by all candidates. Due by 5:00 PM on August 3rd, 2021'. The report's cover/attachment pages continue on PDF p11+ (outside this partial's range).

notes: PDF pages 1-10 of 20. Segment 1 (FINAL report) page map: p1 separator sheet; p2 form Page 1 (candidate info + line 1 = $45.00); p3 form Page 2 (lines 2-6; lines 2-5 print '-' [the form's auto-populate], line 6 = 45.00; signature dated 9/8/2021); p4 form Page 5 (statute excerpt + 'Fields, Tyrone, B' / 9/8/2021); p5 form Page 6 (Attachment A + A-1); p6 form Page 7 (A-1 continuation, printed TOTAL $70.00); p7 form Page 8 (Attachment B, one handwritten row); p8 form Page 9 (Attachment B total + empty Attachment C); p9 form Page 10 (Attachment C continuation, printed TOTAL IN-KIND CONTRIBUTIONS $0.00). Form pages 3-4 are not present in the scan. DISCREPANCY (transcribed verbatim, not resolved): cover lines 2-5 print '-' even though Attachment A lists a $70.00 contribution and Attachment B a $25.00 expenditure; line 6 (45.00) equals line 1, consistent with the blank lines 2-5, and does NOT reconcile with the attachments (45+70-25=90). Handwritten corrections initialed 'TBF' (Tyrone B Fields) appear on the attachments: (a) p5 Attachment A internal box 2 ('more than $50') — printed amount partially obscured by an ink blot, visible '...00' with what appears to be a 7 beneath the blot (almost certainly 70.00, matching the printed A-1 TOTAL $70.00 on p6), margin annotation 'TBF'; (b) p8 Attachment B TOTAL — printed '$0.00' struck through, handwritten '25.00' (second digit slightly ambiguous, could be read 26, but matches the single $25.00 'Filing Fee' row), margin 'TBF'. Expenditure row date is handwritten and ambiguous — read as '6/7/21' (could be '6/1/21'); recipient 'WJC' presumed West Jordan City but transcribed verbatim; row amount written '25.oo' with superscript cents. Attachment B has no mailing address for the WJC row (blank). No in-kind contributions anywhere in range (Attachment C empty, total $0.00). Candidate address on p2 cover is redacted (blacked out). Segment 2 boundary: p10 is the INTERIM report's separator sheet only; that report is mid-report at the p10/p11 edge and continues in the other agent's range.
